text.p: Regional airline Crossair AG, a subsidiary of the SAirGroup, said 1997 net profit was likely to remain around 1996's 23 million Swiss francs ($1.4 billion).

Crossair said in its annual report that it was budgeting for 13 percent rise in flights and passengers transported in 1997 and a 12 percent increase in sales to around 800 million francs from a reported 738 million in 1996.
Crossair also said in its 1996 annual report the sales increase should lead to a significant improvement in operating results.
"However, with lower revenues likely to derive from ancillary sources, our net result is likely to remain largely at 1996 levels," it said. ($ = 1.471 Swiss Francs)
